# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are released for the latest major.minor release line. Maintainers
may also backport a fix to earlier lines.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report a vulnerability privately, through one of:

* GitHub [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/activerecord-hackery/ransack/security/advisories/new)
* the [Tidelift security contact](https://tidelift.com/security), which will
  coordinate the fix and disclosure

Don't open a public issue. See the
[security page](https://activerecord-hackery.github.io/ransack/project/security/)
for what to include and what happens next.
